$why: Tables and columns that exist in the store and that no committed DDL creates.
ETL/schema/check_store_schema.py fails on anything not recorded here, and fails
again once an entry stops being true, so the only direction it can move is down.
Clearing an entry means writing its forward migration into ETL/schema/migrations/
and lowering 'budget' by one. 'budget' is stated separately on purpose:
deleting an entry without lowering it, or lowering it without deleting one, both fail.
2026-11-05: the store moved to Postgres and its DDL became corpus_schema.sql,
which declares company_sector_llm and satr_staging; instrument_application was
already in postgres_schema.sql. The one entry left is the reconciliation table
the load created on purpose (load_into_postgres.py): SQLite's authoring copy of
the gates where it disagreed with the record, held untouched until it is
published through the measured pipeline. It is data in transit, not schema, and
giving it DDL would make it permanent. Clear it by publishing or archiving it.
